source: counter strike but without gravity. the map is 3D with parts that go up and down in xyz coordinate space, not just 2D or 2D with elevation changes. everything else is the same as CS. start with making everything simple polygon. don't worry about backends or multiplayer. make it first person view if possible. put enemies in random places. enemies have HP. you can shoot them and kill them. when an enemy is killed. they respawn.

answers.ask: How deep should the volume be vertically - is up and down as big as across?
answers.answer: Make the vertical depth roughly as large as the map's width and length, so it is a true cubic 3D combat space rather than a flat arena.

answers.ask: With no multiplayer and respawning bots, is there a round or a bomb at all, or is it just shooting targets?
answers.answer: It is just a simple first-person shooting target arena: no rounds, bomb, or other Counter-Strike objectives; bots respawn after being killed.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Shooter map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Lane Network: Parallel routes, classically three, channelling team traffic into predictable engagement fronts.

INCLUDE:
- Flag Stand / Bomb Site: A marked stand or platform at the objective, distinct from the ground around it.
- Lane Pinch Point: Narrow transitions where lanes meet, concentrating fights into contested ground.
- Tactical Cover Arrays: Waist-high (3–4 studs) and full-body (7–8 studs) cover distributed evenly across every lane.
- Opposing Team Bases: Balanced bases at opposite ends of the map, each enclosed so it is not overlooked from open ground.
